paragraphs: Qualcomm Incorporated () is an American multinational technology corporation headquartered in San Diego, California. The company develops and designs technologies for global communications and computing, including next-generation mobile networks, smart devices, and semiconductors — such as mobile processors and artificial intelligence chips. The company holds essential patents for global mobile communication standards including 5G, 4G, CDMA2000, TD-SCDMA and WCDMA.

Founded in 1985 by Irwin Jacobs and six other co-founders, Qualcomm's early research into code-division multiple access (CDMA) wireless technology  was financed through revenue from its Omnitracs satellite communications system. CDMA was later adopted as a 2G standard in North America, incorporating Qualcomm patents. This adoption led to licensing disputes over pricing and access to essential patents.

Over time, Qualcomm expanded into semiconductor products, operating largely under a fabless manufacturing model. Its Snapdragon line of processors is widely used in smartphones and other smart devices by multiple manufacturers. In recent years, Qualcomm has been expanding into areas including embedded artificial intelligence, automotive applications, the Internet of Things (IoT), augmented reality, and virtual reality, in addition to developing the Dragonwing product line, aimed at industrial and enterprise solutions with a focus on embedded AI, edge computing, and advanced connectivity.

In addition to its technological activities, Qualcomm has faced legal and regulatory disputes in several countries, particularly concerning patent licensing and competition practices. The company has been involved in antitrust cases led by authorities in the United States, the European Union, and Asia, as well as litigation with manufacturers such as Apple.

images.caption: The headquarters of Qualcomm in the La Jolla area of San Diego, California. Photographed on December 26, 2015 by user Coolcaesar.

people.name: Cristiano R. Amon
people.title: President and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Amon joined Qualcomm in 1995 as an engineer and has held several technical and leadership positions. He previously served as President and as Executive Vice President, QTI and President, QCT.
people.quote: Cristiano R. Amon, age 55, has served as President and Chief Executive Officer and as a member of the Board of Directors since June 2021.

people.name: Heather Ace
people.title: Chief Human Resources Officer
people.bio: Ace previously served as Senior Vice President, Human Resources at DexCom and Executive Vice President, Human Resources at Orexigen Therapeutics. She began her career as a litigation and transactional employment attorney at Gray, Cary, Ware & Freidenrich.
people.quote: Heather Ace, age 55, has served as Chief Human Resources Officer since March 2020.

people.name: Baaziz Achour
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Technology Officer, QTI
people.bio: Achour joined Qualcomm as a Systems Engineer in 1993. He previously served as Chief Technology Officer - Elect, Deputy Chief Technology Officer and Senior Vice President, Engineering.
people.quote: Baaziz Achour, age 64, has served as Chief Technology Officer, QTI since February 2025.

people.name: Ann Chaplin
people.title: Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary
people.bio: Chaplin previously held corporate secretary and deputy general counsel roles at General Motors. Before General Motors, she was an attorney at Fish & Richardson, last serving as Litigation Practice Group Leader/Litigation Equity Principal.
people.quote: Ann Chaplin, age 52, has served as General Counsel and Corporate Secretary since November 2021.

people.name: Akash Palkhiwala
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Chief Operating Officer
people.bio: Palkhiwala has served as Chief Financial Officer since November 2019 and Chief Operating Officer since January 2024. He joined Qualcomm in March 2001 and previously held finance and treasury leadership roles; before Qualcomm, he was an Analyst at KeyBank.
people.quote: Akash Palkhiwala, age 50, has served as Chief Financial Officer since November 2019 and as Chief Operating Officer since January 2024.

people.name: Alexander H. Rogers
people.title: Executive Vice President and President, Qualcomm Technology Licensing and Global Affairs
people.bio: Rogers joined Qualcomm in January 2001 as an attorney and previously led Qualcomm's litigation group. Before joining Qualcomm, he was a partner at Gray, Cary, Ware & Freidenrich, specializing in intellectual property and commercial litigation.
people.quote: Alexander H. Rogers, age 68, has served as President, QTL and Global Affairs since June 2021.

people.name: Jamie S. Miller
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Miller has served as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of PayPal since November 2023 and as Chief Operating Officer since February 2025. She previously held senior financial and operational roles at EY, Cargill and GE.
people.quote: Ms. Miller has served as Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer of PayPal Holdings, Inc., a leading digital payments company, since November 2023

people.name: Marie Myers
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Myers has been Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Hewlett Packard Enterprise since January 2024. She previously served as Chief Financial Officer of HP and UiPath.
people.quote: Ms. Myers has been Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company (HPE), a global edge-to-cloud technology company, since January 2024.

people.name: Irene B. Rosenfeld
